narrative:
Van Wert County has 19,953 registered voters, with 54.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 7.6%, a pronounced Republican lean of 30.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.3% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -14.9% D−R vs -40.5% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
